import pandas as pd

# Load the time_series_data.csv dataset
df_time_series = pd.read_csv('/data/time_series_data.csv')

# Extract the 'CE' and 'Depot' columns
ce_values = df_time_series['CE'].values
depot_values = df_time_series['Depot'].values

# Identify the index of the maximum Depot value
max_index = depot_values.argmax()

# Find the corresponding CE value
peak_ce = ce_values[max_index]

# Determine the century
peak_century = peak_ce // 100 if peak_ce >= 0 else (peak_ce - 99) // 100

peak_century

import pandas as pd

# Load the time_series_data.csv dataset
df_time_series = pd.read_csv('/data/time_series_data.csv')

# Filter out rows with missing 'Depot' values
df_time_series_clean = df_time_series.dropna(subset=['Depot'])

# Extract the 'CE' and 'Depot' columns from the cleaned dataset
ce_values_clean = df_time_series_clean['CE'].values
depot_values_clean = df_time_series_clean['Depot'].values

# Identify the index of the maximum Depot value
max_index_clean = depot_values_clean.argmax()

# Find the corresponding CE value
peak_ce_clean = ce_values_clean[max_index_clean]

# Determine the century
peak_century_clean = peak_ce_clean // 100 if peak_ce_clean >= 0 else (peak_ce_clean - 99) // 100

peak_century_clean
